desk.sentence: the executed book's word does not depend on the caliber choice (A and P agree), so the caliber argument cannot change what the gate says about the money
desk.second_reading: the judge and the money are two different objects: the judged book's word survives the caliber choice, while ticket_construction_plain_plus_overlay -- the construction the ticket prices -- reads ADMIT only while a partial year counts as a year (r1440 priced the same k_now)
desk.size_cap_note: no size change may cite an arm whose word moves on a blind check; the weight in force is the weight until a prereg lands

prereg_requirements: freeze the caliber in the receipt, not in a sentence: every book re-read under the chosen caliber and the parity table published with the choice (r1445 rows are the baseline to hold identical)
state the forward test that would settle it before reading it: fixed-length windows, min_cells 12, 2000 permutations, and the same severity order used in r1444 (inverted is worse than blind)
carry a power floor: with four decision points the selector cannot settle a strategy question (r1316) -- a caliber that only re-ranks blind checks is a re-labeling, not an admission rule
name what changes for money on adoption: which executing book's word moves, at what weight, and the size cap in force while the caliber is unsettled
honest: no repricing and no engine call: every number is re-read from published receipts, so a word here is a statement about the same numbers
the forward receipt publishes one composite verdict per axis, not per check; every year-axis check inherits it and that inheritance is printed in forward.source
classification says what the receipts can support, nothing about expected return
caliber P stays unadopted: this page decides what to do while the caliber is unsettled, it does not choose the caliber
the gift-arm list is a reading of the caliber receipt; the cross-receipt block re-checks each wrapper word against the caliber receipt's A word
